compass: 719a risk-manager baseline plus OAS decision and VIX extension (2026-04-28)

baseline.name: 719a_zero_center_normalized_innovation_sticky_zero_readout_frozen
baseline.framework_claim: single AR normalized-innovation flow mechanism with deterministic train-derived sticky readout; evaluated on iv_only, anchor_only, and joint
known_strengths: IV surface/spatial realism, ACF, kurtosis, cointegration, mean reversion, and pathwise jump realism pass under the risk-manager framing
anchor and joint factor tail scale pass 13/13
anchor and joint conditional panel response pass strongly
known_defects: IV coverage, regime coverage, and distributional calibration remain imperfect
BBB/AAA OAS sticky-spread marginal daily-change law remains the repeated anchor/joint blocker
joint factor-factor mean absolute correlation amplitude narrowly misses the 0.35 gate in 719a

directions.name: OAS-G1: generic high-no-change nonzero-update scale repair
directions.theory: 726a showed history-RMS normalized innovations are stable for SPX/rates but not for sticky OAS nonzero updates. A deterministic, train-derived frequency-aware tail coordinate or balanced nonzero-update objective may make high-no-change channels comparable across regimes without naming OAS or changing the core generator.
directions.target: Improve AAA/BBB OAS factor KS in anchor_only and joint while preserving IV realism, factor tail scale, conditional response, factor-factor dependence, and IV-factor co-movement.
allowed_changes: coordinate/objective repair applied identically by rule across iv_only, anchor_only, and joint
same AR normalized-innovation flow backend and stochastic source
forbidden_changes: switching backend before falsifying this repair

directions.name: OAS-LIMIT: document sticky spread limitation if OAS-G1 fails
directions.theory: If one clean generic high-no-change repair fails, further OAS tuning risks becoming a research-knob stack. The honest risk-manager/paper claim should document sticky quoted spread factors as the limitation instead of chasing perfection.
directions.target: Produce limitation note and model card language for 719a or its repaired successor.

directions.name: VIX-X1: add VIX as scalar volatility-factor extension
directions.theory: No independent VIX column is available locally, so 729a used a clearly labeled short-ATM-IV-derived `vix_proxy` to test scalar volatility-factor mechanics without external data. This validates the data interface but not an independent VIX law.
directions.target: Validate generalization to a scalar volatility proxy in anchor_only and joint without special treatment.

directions.name: 729A-ATTR: VIX-proxy joint trade-off attribution
directions.theory: 729a passed anchor+VIX and joint+VIX panel realism but regressed the joint IV-facing full suite to 5/11. Before any new model change, classify whether this is the known joint-scope IV calibration trade-off, proxy redundancy/interference from deriving VIX from IV, or a true framework limitation.
directions.target: Compare 729a against 719a/676a/688a on IV full-suite, panel realism, dependency, and VIX-proxy diagnostics, then choose whether to keep the proxy extension as a data-interface capability or pursue a model/objective repair.

exhausted: Observed-positive/log support for OAS (717a): worsened OAS excursions and IV coverage
Simple sticky-zero/atom probability tweaks (719a-721a): helped but capped by BBB nonzero shape
Hybrid/global empirical score coordinate for sticky channels (722a): over-widened tails and contaminated ordinary factors
Masked-zero continuous loss (724a): cleaner observation model but over-learned broad training-tail OAS scale
